provenance.purpose: the item set every published arm accuracy is scored against; staged so the gpt2 floor can be re-measured on an A100 rather than assumed to carry over from the 3090 Ti
provenance.staged_form: the gzip decompressed; the digest below is of the uncompressed bytes, which is what the scorer reads and what baselines.txt publishes
provenance.published_record: wiki tools/extraction-eval/runs/baselines.txt names this digest for both the gpt2 and gpt2-medium floors
provenance.expected_from: that same baselines.txt is what --expect-from must point at; it is the published record, not a file emitted beside these bytes
provenance.note: score the whole set, never a prefix -- items are emitted in sorted page-slug order, so the set is not homogeneous along its own ordering
